description: This file defines the OAuth2TokenInputPipe class, a NestJS PipeTransform implementation that validates OAuth2 token input data, handling different input types and errors.

classes.name: OAuth2TokenInputPipe
classes.description: A NestJS pipe that validates OAuth2 token input data, ensuring required fields and correct types, and handling errors.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Main method that validates the input object, checks grant type, and delegates to specific validation methods.

methods.name: validateExchange
methods.description: Validates exchange input, distinguishing between confidential and public inputs.

methods.name: validateRefresh
methods.description: Validates refresh token input, distinguishing between confidential and public inputs.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Uses class-transformer and class-validator to validate input objects against their classes.

methods.name: formatErrors
methods.description: Formats validation errors into a readable string.

methods.name: isConfidentialExchange
methods.description: Type guard to check if input is a confidential exchange input.

methods.name: isConfidentialRefresh
methods.description: Type guard to check if input is a confidential refresh input.

methods.name: throwOAuthError
methods.description: Throws an OAuth2HttpException with a given error description.
